body.translated_text: <s>Kṛṣṇāmṛtamahārṇava</s> (The Great Ocean of the Nectar of <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>)
<s>Oṃ</s>.

body.text: arcitaḥ saṃsmṛto dhyātaḥ kīrtitaḥ kathitaḥ śrutaḥ

children.text: yo dadāty amṛtatvaṃ hi sa māṃ rakṣatu keśavaḥ. || 1 ||
children.translated_text: may he who grants immortality, <s>Keśava</s>, protect me. // <s>MKm</s> 1 //

body.translated_text: Worshipped, remembered, meditated upon, praised, spoken of, and heard —

body.text: tāpatrayeṇa saṃtaptaṃ yad etad akhilaṃ jagat

children.translated_text: I shall expound, for its pacification, the Great Ocean of the Nectar of <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>. // <s>MKm</s> 2 //

body.translated_text: Since this entire world is tormented by the threefold affliction (<s>tāpatraya</s>),

body.text: te narāḥ paśavo loke kiṃ teṣāṃ jīvane phalam

children.text: yair na labdhā harer dīkṣā nārcito vā janārdanaḥ. || 3 ||
children.translated_text: who have not obtained initiation (<s>dīkṣā</s>) from <s>Hari</s>, nor worshipped <s>Janārdana</s>? // <s>MKm</s> 3 //

body.translated_text: Those people are [mere] animals in the world — what fruit is there in their living

children.text: ayam eko mahābhāgaḥ pūjyate yad adhokṣajaḥ. || 4 ||
children.translated_text: this alone is supremely fortunate: that <s>Adhokṣaja</s> (<s>Viṣṇu</s>) is worshipped. // <s>MKm</s> 4 //

body.translated_text: In this most terrible <s>saṃsāra</s>, filled with the fear of birth and disease,

body.text: sa nāma sukṛtī loke kulaṃ tena hy alaṃkṛtam

children.translated_text: he who is the support of all beings, by whom <s>Viṣṇu</s> has been pleased. // <s>MKm</s> 5 //

body.translated_text: He is truly one of good deeds in the world; by him the family is adorned —

body.text: yajñānāṃ tapasāṃ caiva śubhānāṃ caiva karmaṇāṃ

children.translated_text: the most excellent fruit for men is always the worship of <s>Hari</s>. // <s>MKm</s> 6 //

body.translated_text: Of sacrifices, austerities, and auspicious deeds,

children.text: ye 'rcayanti narā nityaṃ te 'pi vandyā yathā hariḥ. || 7 ||
children.translated_text: those men too are worthy of reverence, just as <s>Hari</s> [himself]. // <s>MKm</s> 7 //

body.translated_text: In the <s>Kali</s> [age], those who constantly worship <s>Hari</s>, who destroys the impurities of <s>Kali</s> and removes all sins —

body.text: nāsti śreyaskaraṃ nṛṇāṃ viṣṇor ārādhanān mune

children.text: yuge 'smiṃs tāmase loke satataṃ pūjyate nṛbhiḥ. || 8 ||
children.translated_text: in this dark age, he is constantly worshipped by men. // <s>MKm</s> 8 //

body.translated_text: There is nothing more beneficial for men, O sage, than the worship of <s>Viṣṇu</s>;

children.text: arcitāḥ sarvadevāḥ syur yataḥ sarvagato hariḥ. || 9 ||
children.translated_text: all the gods are [thereby] worshipped, since <s>Hari</s> pervades all. // <s>MKm</s> 9 //

body.translated_text: When the Lord of all gods, the bearer of conch, discus, and mace, is worshipped,

children.text: keśave kaṃsakeśighne na yāti narakaṃ naraḥ. || 10 ||
children.translated_text: <s>Keśava</s>, the slayer of <s>Kaṃsa</s>'s glory, is well worshipped, a person does not go to hell. // <s>MKm</s> 10 //

body.translated_text: When the Lord of all worlds, bowed to by gods and <s>asuras</s>,

children.translated_text: becomes a sharer in liberation, free from anxiety, and dwells long in the world of <s>Viṣṇu</s>. // <s>MKm</s> 11 //

body.translated_text: A person who has worshipped <s>Govinda</s> even once with a <s>bilva</s> leaf

children.text: sa yāti paramaṃ sthānaṃ yat surair api durlabham. || 12 ||
children.translated_text: that person attains the supreme abode, which is difficult to obtain even for the gods. // <s>MKm</s> 12 //

body.translated_text: He by whom [<s>Viṣṇu</s>] has been worshipped even once, or bowed to even playfully —

children.translated_text: <s>Nārada</s> [said]:
The worship of the Blessed <s>Viṣṇu</s> himself, the Lord of all worlds,

children.text: sākṣād bhagavato viṣṇoḥ pūjanaṃ janmanaḥ phalam. || 13 ||
children.translated_text: the God of gods, the bearer of the <s>Śārṅga</s> bow — that is the fruit of birth. // <s>MKm</s> 13 //
<s>Pulastya</s> [said]:
When the Supreme Person (<s>Puruṣottama</s>) is worshipped with devotion by men with sprouts of <s>dūrvā</s> grass,

children.text: harir dadāti hi phalaṃ sarvayajñaiś ca durlabham. || 14 ||
children.translated_text: <s>Hari</s> grants a fruit that is difficult to obtain even through all sacrifices. // <s>MKm</s> 14 //
according to the prescribed rite — he grants an easily accessible fruit, even when worshipped with [mere] water. // <s>MKm</s> 15 //

body.translated_text: When the Lord of the God of gods, <s>Hari</s>, bearer of conch and discus, is worshipped

children.text: kiṃ tvayā nārcito devaḥ keśavaḥ kleśanāśanaḥ. || 16 ||
children.translated_text: 'Why did you not worship the god <s>Keśava</s>, the destroyer of afflictions?' // <s>MKm</s> 16 //

body.translated_text: One being cooked in hell is rebuked by <s>Yama</s>:

children.translated_text: <s>Dharma</s> [said]:
<s>Narasiṃha</s>, <s>Hṛṣīkeśa</s>, with eyes like lotuses —

children.text: smaraṇān muktido nṛṇāṃ sa tvayā kiṃ na pūjitaḥ. || 17 ||
children.translated_text: he who grants liberation to men by mere remembrance — why was he not worshipped by you? // <s>MKm</s> 17 //

body.text: dravyāṇām apy abhāve tu salilenāpi pūjitaḥ

children.text: yo dadāti svakaṃ sthānaṃ sa tvayā kiṃ na pūjitaḥ. || 18 ||
children.translated_text: grants his own abode — why was he not worshipped by you? // <s>MKm</s> 18 //

body.translated_text: Even in the absence of [ritual] materials, he who, when worshipped with mere water,

children.text: na prāptā yair harer dīkṣā sarvaduḥkhavimocanī. || 19 ||
children.translated_text: those who have not obtained initiation from <s>Hari</s>, which liberates from all suffering. // <s>MKm</s> 19 //

body.translated_text: Even those dwelling in the womb, or those whose [lives are] nectar, are stolen and corrupted —

children.translated_text: <s>Mārkaṇḍeya</s> [said]:
He by whom the God of gods, <s>Janārdana</s>, has been worshipped even once —

children.text: yat kṛtaṃ tatkṛtaṃ tena samprāptaṃ paramaṃ padam. || 20 ||
children.translated_text: what was done by him is [truly] done; [he has] attained the supreme state. // <s>MKm</s> 20 //
— I speak the truth, O Lord of gods — than the worship of <s>Hṛṣīkeśa</s>. // <s>MKm</s> 21 //

body.translated_text: There is no other means for <s>dharma</s>, wealth, desire, and liberation

children.text: praṇāmaṃ ye 'pi kurvanti teṣām api namo namaḥ. || 22 ||
children.translated_text: of immeasurable splendor — homage, homage to them too! // <s>MKm</s> 22 //

body.translated_text: To those who bow even before that <s>Yajñavarāha</s> (<s>Viṣṇu</s> as the sacrificial boar),

children.translated_text: <s>Marīci</s> [said]:
By men who have not worshipped <s>Govinda</s>, O prince,

children.text: na hi samprāpyate śreṣṭhaṃ tasmād ārādhayācyutam. || 23 ||
children.translated_text: the supreme abode is not attained — therefore worship <s>Acyuta</s>. // <s>MKm</s> 23 //
<s>Atri</s> [said]:

children.text: paraḥ parāṇāṃ puruṣas tuṣṭo yasya janārdanaḥ
children.translated_text: He with whom <s>Janārdana</s>, the Supreme Person, the highest of the high, is pleased —

children.text: sa cā 'pnoty akṣayaṃ sthānam etat satyaṃ mayoditam. || 24 ||
children.translated_text: he attains the imperishable abode. This truth has been declared by me. // <s>MKm</s> 24 //
<s>Aṅgiras</s> [said]:
He within whom is all this [universe], <s>Acyuta</s>, whose self is designated [thus] —

children.text: tam ārādhaya govindaṃ sthānam agryaṃ yadīcchasi. || 25 ||
children.translated_text: worship that <s>Govinda</s>, if you desire the highest abode. // <s>MKm</s> 25 //
<s>Pulaha</s> [said]:

children.text: paraṃ brahma paraṃ dhāma yo 'sau brahma sanātanam
children.translated_text: He who is the Supreme <s>Brahman</s>, the Supreme Abode, the eternal <s>Brahman</s> —

children.text: tam ārādhya hariṃ yāti muktim apy atidurlabhām. || 26 ||
children.translated_text: by worshipping <s>Hari</s>, one attains liberation, which is extremely difficult to obtain. // <s>MKm</s> 26 //

body.text: aindram indraḥ paraṃ sthānaṃ yam ārādhya jagatpatim

children.text: prāpa yajñapatiṃ viṣṇuṃ tam ārādhaya suvrata. || 27 ||
children.translated_text: <s>Viṣṇu</s>, the Lord of sacrifices — worship him, O one of excellent vows. // <s>MKm</s> 27 //

body.translated_text: <s>Indra</s> obtained his supreme station by worshipping the Lord of the world,

body.text: prāpnoty ārādhite viṣṇau manasā yad yad icchati

children.translated_text: one obtains — any station within the three worlds, let alone those ever more transcendent. // <s>MKm</s> 28 //

body.translated_text: When <s>Viṣṇu</s> is worshipped, whatever one desires in the mind

children.translated_text: freed from all sins, they enter the Supreme <s>Brahman</s>. // <s>MKm</s> 29 //

body.translated_text: Those who always remember <s>Viṣṇu</s>, the bearer of conch, discus, and mace,

body.text: tato 'niruddhaṃ deveśaṃ pradyumnaṃ ca tataḥ param

children.text: tataḥ saṃkarṣaṇaṃ devaṃ vāsudevaṃ parāt param. || 30 ||
children.translated_text: then <s>Saṃkarṣaṇa</s>, the god, and <s>Vāsudeva</s>, the highest of the highest. // <s>MKm</s> 30 //

body.translated_text: Then <s>Aniruddha</s>, Lord of gods, and then <s>Pradyumna</s> beyond,

children.translated_text: For those who have entered <s>Vāsudeva</s>, whence could there be return? // <s>MKm</s> 31 //

body.translated_text: There is nothing higher than <s>Vāsudeva</s> — this is the conclusion of <s>Vedānta</s>.

children.translated_text: <s>Ātreya</s> [said]:

children.text: yo yān icchen naraḥ kāmān nārī vā varavarṇinī
children.translated_text: Whatever desires a man or a woman of excellent complexion may wish for,
those abundant [desires] one obtains by worshipping <s>Janārdana</s>. // <s>MKm</s> 32 //

body.translated_text: <s>Pulaha</s> said:

children.translated_text: <s>Brahmā</s> [said]:

children.text: bāhubhyāṃ sāgaraṃ tartuṃ ka iccheta pumān bhuvi
children.translated_text: What man on earth would wish to cross the ocean with [just] his arms?

children.text: vāsudevam anārādhya ko mokṣaṃ gantum icchati. || 33 ||
children.translated_text: Who would wish to attain liberation without worshipping <s>Vāsudeva</s>? // <s>MKm</s> 33 //
<s>Śaṃkara</s> [said]:

children.text: kṛte pāpe 'nutāpo vai yasya puṃsaḥ prajāyate
children.translated_text: For the man in whom remorse arises after committing a sin,
the supreme expiation (<s>prāyaścitta</s>) prescribed is the remembrance of <s>Hari</s>. // <s>MKm</s> 34 //

body.text: na hy apuṇyavatāṃ loke mūḍhānāṃ kuṭilātmanāṃ

children.text: bhaktir bhavati govinde smaraṇaṃ kīrtanaṃ tathā. || 35 ||
children.translated_text: devotion to <s>Govinda</s>, remembrance, and recitation do not arise. // <s>MKm</s> 35 //

body.translated_text: For the meritless in this world — the deluded, the crooked-hearted —

children.translated_text: his senses conquered, his soul purified — the very moment he remembers <s>Hari</s>. // <s>MKm</s> 36 //

body.translated_text: A person is liberated from the sufferings of birth, old age, and the rest,

children.text: na kaścit smarate devaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ kalimalāpaham. || 37 ||
children.translated_text: no one remembers the god <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>, the remover of the impurities of <s>Kali</s>. // <s>MKm</s> 37 //

body.translated_text: When the terrible <s>Kali</s> age has arrived, devoid of <s>dharma</s> and knowledge,

children.text: karoti martyo mūḍhātmā smaraṇaṃ kīrtanaṃ hareḥ. || 38 ||
children.translated_text: the remembrance and recitation of <s>Hari</s>, the God of gods, the remover of the suffering of birth. // <s>MKm</s> 38 //

body.translated_text: In the <s>Kali</s> [age], the deluded mortal does not perform

children.text: te prayānti bhavaṃ tyaktvā viṣṇulokam anāmayam. || 39 ||
children.translated_text: go forth, abandoning worldly existence, to the world of <s>Viṣṇu</s>, free from affliction. // <s>MKm</s> 39 //

body.translated_text: Those who always remember <s>Viṣṇu</s> with a purified inner self

children.text: na bādhyate naro nityaṃ vāsudevam anusmaran. || 40 ||
children.translated_text: a man who constantly remembers <s>Vāsudeva</s> is never afflicted. // <s>MKm</s> 40 //

body.translated_text: By the bonds of <s>saṃsāra</s> — womb, birth, old age, disease, and suffering —

children.text: svapne 'pi ca na paśyeta yaḥ smared garuḍadhvajam. || 41 ||
children.translated_text: one who remembers him whose banner bears <s>Garuḍa</s> does not see them even in a dream. // <s>MKm</s> 41 //

body.translated_text: The terrible path of <s>Yama</s>, the hells, and <s>Yama</s> himself —

body.text: hṛdi rūpaṃ mukhe nāma naivedyam udare hareḥ

children.text: pādodakaṃ ca nirmālyaṃ mastake yasya so 'cyutaḥ. || 42 ||
children.translated_text: his foot-water and his garland on the head — such a one is [truly] <s>Acyuta</s>'s. // <s>MKm</s> 42 //

body.translated_text: The form of <s>Hari</s> in the heart, his name on the lips, his food-offering in the stomach,

children.translated_text: it burns without doubt, swiftly, like fire [consuming] a heap of cotton. // <s>MKm</s> 43 //

body.translated_text: The remembrance of <s>Govinda</s>, for men, [reduces] the great mountain of the mass of sins —

children.translated_text: <s>Agastya</s> [said]:
By the mere remembrance of <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>, the cage of the accumulated mass of sins

children.text: śatadhā bhedam āyāti girir vajrahato tathā. || 44 ||
children.translated_text: breaks into a hundred pieces, like a mountain struck by a thunderbolt. // <s>MKm</s> 44 //

body.text: kṛṣṇe ratāḥ kṛṣṇam anusmarantaḥ tad bhāvitās tad gatamānasāś ca.

children.text: te bhinnadehāḥ praviśanti viṣṇuṃ havir yathā mantrahutaṃ hutāśe. || 45 ||
children.translated_text: they, upon leaving the body, enter <s>Viṣṇu</s>, like an oblation duly offered with <s>mantras</s> into the fire. // <s>MKm</s> 45 //

body.translated_text: Devoted to <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>, remembering <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>, absorbed in him, with minds gone to him —

body.text: sā hānis tan mahat chidraṃ sā cāndhajaḍamūkatā

children.text: yan muhūrtaṃ kṣaṇaṃ vā 'pi vāsudevo na cintyate. || 46 ||
children.translated_text: any moment or instant in which <s>Vāsudeva</s> is not contemplated. // <s>MKm</s> 46 //

body.translated_text: That is loss, that is the great deficiency, that is blindness, stupor, and muteness —

body.text: nārāyaṇo nāma naro narāṇāṃ prasaṃhya coraḥ kathitaḥ pṛthivyām

children.translated_text: burns completely the accumulation of sins acquired over countless births, by mere remembrance alone. // <s>MKm</s> 47 //

body.translated_text: <s>Nārāyaṇa</s>, the most formidable 'thief' among men — so he is called on earth —

children.translated_text: sins accumulated over ten million births are instantly destroyed. // <s>MKm</s> 48 //

body.translated_text: By the mere remembrance of <s>Vāsudeva</s>, bearer of the <s>Śārṅga</s> bow,

body.text: kiṃ tasya bahubhis tīrthaiḥ kiṃ tapobhiḥ kim adhvaraiḥ

children.text: yo nityaṃ dhyāyate devaṃ nārāyaṇam ananyadhīḥ. || 49 ||
children.translated_text: he who constantly meditates on the god <s>Nārāyaṇa</s> with undivided mind? // <s>MKm</s> 49 //

body.translated_text: What need has he of many pilgrimages, of austerities, of sacrifices —

body.text: ye mānavā vigatarāgaparāvarajñā nārāyaṇaṃ suraguruṃ satataṃ smaranti

children.text: dhyānena tena hatakilbiṣacetanāste mātuḥ payodhararasaṃ na punaḥ pibanti. || 50 ||
children.translated_text: their consciousness purified of sin through that meditation, they never again drink the milk from the mother's breast [i.e., are never reborn]. // <s>MKm</s> 50 //

body.translated_text: Those men free from passion and the knowledge of higher and lower, who constantly remember <s>Nārāyaṇa</s>, the teacher of the gods —

body.text: he citta cintaya sveha vāsudevam aharniśam

children.text: nūnaṃ yaś cintitaḥ puṃsāṃ hanti saṃsārabandhanam. || 51 ||
children.translated_text: surely he who is contemplated by men destroys the bondage of <s>saṃsāra</s>. // <s>MKm</s> 51 //

body.translated_text: O mind, contemplate <s>Vāsudeva</s> here, day and night —

body.text: āloḍya sarvaśāstrāṇi vicārya ca punaḥ punaḥ

children.text: idam ekaṃ suniṣpannaṃ dhyeyo nārāyaṇaḥ sadā. || 52 ||
children.translated_text: this one conclusion is well-established: <s>Nārāyaṇa</s> is to be meditated upon always. // <s>MKm</s> 52 //

body.translated_text: Having churned all the <s>śāstras</s> and deliberated again and again,

children.text: puruṣas tam ajaṃ nityaṃ vrajāmi śaraṇaṃ harim. || 53 ||
children.translated_text: I go for refuge always to that <s>Hari</s>, the unborn, the eternal. // <s>MKm</s> 53 //

body.translated_text: When remembered, [he] in whom one becomes a vessel of all auspiciousness —

body.text: vedeṣu yajñeṣu tapasu caiva dāneṣu tīrtheṣu vrateṣu caiva

children.text: iṣṭeṣu pūrteṣu ca yat pradiṣṭaṃ puṇyaṃ smṛte tat khalu vāsudeve. || 54 ||
children.translated_text: in <s>iṣṭa</s> and <s>pūrta</s> [rites] — whatever merit is prescribed, that [same merit arises] when <s>Vāsudeva</s> is remembered. // <s>MKm</s> 54 //

body.translated_text: In the <s>Vedas</s>, in sacrifices, in austerities, in gifts, in pilgrimages, in vows,

children.translated_text: <s>Aurva</s> [said]:

children.text: ārādhayaiva naro viṣṇuṃ manaso yad yad icchati
children.translated_text: A man who worships <s>Viṣṇu</s> obtains fully

children.text: phalaṃ prāpnoty avikalaṃ bhūri svalpam athāpi vā. || 55 ||
children.translated_text: whatever fruit his mind desires, whether great or small. // <s>MKm</s> 55 //
O <s>Maitreya</s>, [<s>Viṣṇu</s>] is like fire for the elements of all sins. || 56 ||

body.translated_text: The recitation of whose name with devotion is the supreme dissolution [of sins] —

children.translated_text: instantly goes to dissolution when <s>Acyuta</s> is glorified even once. || 57 ||

body.translated_text: The terrible impurity of the <s>Kali</s> age, which inflicts the torment of hell upon humans,

children.translated_text: [yet] <s>Śakra</s> (Indra) and other adversaries arise to obstruct that [attainment]. || 58 ||

body.translated_text: Those who have taken refuge in <s>Keśava</s> attain liberation effortlessly;

children.translated_text: there is no man other than <s>Keśava</s> who is the healer of all sins. || 59 ||

body.translated_text: Throughout the supreme <s>Jambūdvīpa</s> encircled by the four oceans,

body.text: yad abhyarcya hariṃ bhaktyā kṛte varṣaśatair api

children.text: phalaṃ prāpnoty avikalaṃ kalau saṃkīrtya keśavam. || 60 ||
children.translated_text: that same complete fruit one obtains in the <s>Kali</s> age by simply glorifying <s>Keśava</s>. || 60 ||

body.translated_text: The fruit which one obtains by worshipping <s>Hari</s> with devotion for hundreds of years in the <s>Kṛta</s> age,

body.text: kṣīyate tu yadā dharmaḥ prāpte ghore kalau yuge

children.text: tadā na kīrtayet kaścin muktidaṃ devam acyutam. || 61 ||
children.translated_text: then no one will glorify <s>Acyuta</s>, the god who grants liberation. || 61 ||

body.translated_text: But when <s>Dharma</s> declines with the arrival of the terrible <s>Kali</s> age,

children.translated_text: is immediately freed from all sins, like deer [freed] from a terrifying lion. || 62 ||

body.translated_text: Even when His name is uttered involuntarily, a person

children.text: tathā 'pi narake ghore majjantīty etad adbhutam. || 63 ||
children.translated_text: yet still people sink into terrible hell — this is truly astonishing! || 63 ||

body.translated_text: The <s>mantra</s> '<s>Nārāyaṇa</s>' exists, and speech is under one's own control —

body.text: ārtā viṣaṇṇāḥ śithilāś ca bhītā ghoreṣu ca vyādhiṣu vartamānāḥ

children.translated_text: merely by glorifying the word '<s>Nārāyaṇa</s>', they become freed from suffering and happy. || 64 ||

body.translated_text: Those who are afflicted, despondent, weakened, and frightened, and those suffering from terrible diseases —

children.translated_text: <s>Kauśika</s> [said]:

children.text: sakṛd uccāritaṃ yais tu kṛṣṇeti na viśanti te
children.translated_text: Those who have uttered '<s>Kṛṣṇa</s>' even once do not enter

children.text: garbhāgāraṃ gṛhaṃ mātur yamalokaṃ ca dussaham. || 65 ||
children.translated_text: the womb-chamber, the mother's house, or the unbearable world of <s>Yama</s>. || 65 ||
and the recitation of '<s>Vāsudeva</s>', the unsurpassed seed of liberation? || 66 ||

body.translated_text: What comparison is there between going to the back of heaven, which is characterized by return,

body.text: buddhyā buddhvā vadasvainaṃ harir ity akṣaradvayam

children.text: smaraṇād eva kṛṣṇasya na punarjāyate kvacit. || 67 ||
children.translated_text: By merely remembering <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>, one is never born again anywhere. || 67 ||

body.translated_text: Having understood with the intellect, speak these two syllables: '<s>Hari</s>.'

body.text: he jihve mama nisnehe hariṃ kiṃ nuna bhāṣase

children.translated_text: Speak of <s>Hari</s>, O auspicious one! <s>Hari</s> is the boat across the ocean of <s>saṃsāra</s>. || 68 ||

body.translated_text: O tongue of mine, devoid of affection! Why do you not speak of <s>Hari</s>?

body.text: asāre khalu saṃsāre sārāt sārataro hariḥ

children.text: puṇyahīnā na vindanti sāraṅgāś ca yathā jalam. || 69 ||
children.translated_text: [but] the meritless do not find [Him], just as <s>sāraṅga</s> birds [do not find] water. || 69 ||

body.translated_text: In this truly essenceless <s>saṃsāra</s>, <s>Hari</s> is the essence of essences;

body.text: kurukṣetreṇa kiṃ tasya kiṃ kāśyā puṣkareṇa vā

children.text: jihvāgre vartate tasya harir ity akṣaradvayam. || 70 ||
children.translated_text: on the tip of whose tongue abide the two syllables '<s>Hari</s>'? || 70 ||

body.translated_text: What need has one for <s>Kurukṣetra</s>, for <s>Kāśī</s>, or for <s>Puṣkara</s>,

children.translated_text: <s>Brahmā</s> said:

children.text: asāre khalu saṃsāre sāram ekaṃ nirūpitam
children.translated_text: In this truly essenceless <s>saṃsāra</s>, one thing has been determined as the essence:
the worship of <s>Hari</s>, the lord of all worlds — that is the essence. || 71 ||

body.text: sā jihvā yā hariṃ stauti tac cittaṃ yat tadarpaṇam

children.text: tāv eva kevalau ślāghyau yau tatpūjākarau karau. || 72 ||
children.translated_text: those hands alone are praiseworthy which perform His worship. || 72 ||

body.translated_text: That tongue is [truly a] tongue which praises <s>Hari</s>; that mind is [truly a] mind which is devoted to Him;

body.text: yas tu viṣṇuparo nityaṃ dṛḍhabhaktir jitendriyaḥ

children.text: svagṛhe 'pi vasan yāti tad viṣṇoḥ paramaṃ padam. || 73 ||
children.translated_text: even while dwelling in one's own home, attains that supreme abode of <s>Viṣṇu</s>. || 73 ||

body.translated_text: One who is always devoted to <s>Viṣṇu</s>, with firm devotion and senses conquered,

children.translated_text: <s>Śaṅkara</s> [said]:
Excellent, excellent, O greatly fortunate one! Excellent, O destroyer of <s>Dānavas</s>!

children.text: yan māṃ pṛcchasi dharmajña keśavārādhanaṃ prati. || 74 ||
children.translated_text: That you ask me, O knower of <s>Dharma</s>, about the worship of <s>Keśava</s>. || 74 ||

body.text: nimiṣaṃ nimiṣārdhaṃ vā muhūrtam api bhārgava

children.translated_text: does devotion to <s>Keśava</s> exist for those whose sins are not entirely burned. || 75 ||

body.translated_text: Not for an instant, not for half an instant, not even for a moment, O <s>Bhārgava</s>,

body.text: kiṃ tena manasā kāryaṃ yan na tiṣṭhati keśave

children.translated_text: The mind is the cause and instrument for the attainment of the fruit of liberation. || 76 ||

body.translated_text: What use is a mind that does not abide in <s>Keśava</s>?

body.text: rogo nāma na sā jihvā yayā na stūyate hariḥ

children.text: gartau nāma na tau karṇau yābhyāṃ tat karma na śrutam. || 77 ||
children.translated_text: they are pits, not ears, by which His deeds are not heard. || 77 ||

body.translated_text: It is a disease, not a tongue, that does not praise <s>Hari</s>;

children.text: rogo nāma na sā jihvā yā na vakti harer guṇān. || 78 ||
children.translated_text: it is a disease, not a tongue, that does not speak of the virtues of <s>Hari</s>. || 78 ||

body.translated_text: Surely it is a goiter of the throat, or else a secondary tongue [growth] —

children.text: bhārabhūtaiḥ kāryam ebhiḥ kiṃ tasya nṛpaśor dvija
children.translated_text: What use are these [limbs], which are mere burdens, to that human wretch, O twice-born?
Those two feet alone are fruitful which go to the temple of <s>Keśava</s>;

children.text: te ca netre mahābhāga yābhyāṃ sandṛśyate hariḥ. || 79 ||
children.translated_text: and those eyes alone, O greatly fortunate one, by which <s>Hari</s> is seen. || 79 ||

body.text: kiṃ tasya caraṇaiḥ kāryaṃ vṛthāsañcaraṇair dvija

children.text: yair hi na vrajate jantuḥ keśavālayadarśane. || 80 ||
children.translated_text: by which a creature does not go to behold the temple of <s>Keśava</s>? || 80 ||

body.translated_text: What use are those feet which merely wander in vain, O twice-born,

children.translated_text: whose souls are purified, O knower of <s>Dharma</s>, should be known as born from His grace. || 81 ||

body.translated_text: Even the <s>ṛṣi</s>-hood of sages who know the <s>Vedas</s> and <s>Vedāṅgas</s>,

children.translated_text: they delight with celestial women — such is the fruit of remembering <s>Keśava</s>. || 82 ||

body.translated_text: On jeweled couches of wondrous splendor, enjoying great pleasures,

children.text: nāsau tat phalam āpnoti tadbhaktair yad avāpyate. || 83 ||
children.translated_text: does not obtain that fruit which is obtained by His devotees. || 83 ||

body.translated_text: Even one who performs a thousand <s>Aśvamedha</s> sacrifices a thousandfold

body.text: re re manuṣyāḥ puruṣottamasya karau na kasmān mukulīkurudhve

children.text: kriyājuṣāṃ ko bhavatāṃ prayāsaḥ phalaṃ hi yat padam acyutasya. || 84 ||
children.translated_text: What effort is there for you in performing rituals? For the fruit is the abode of <s>Acyuta</s>. || 84 ||

body.translated_text: O people! Why do you not fold your hands in reverence to the Supreme Person (<s>Puruṣottama</s>)?

body.text: viṣṇor vimānaṃ yaḥ kuryāt sakṛd bhaktyā pradakṣiṇam

children.translated_text: obtains the fruit of a thousand <s>Aśvamedha</s> sacrifices. || 85 ||

body.translated_text: One who performs a single circumambulation of <s>Viṣṇu's</s> temple with devotion

body.text: pradakṣiṇaṃ tu yaḥ kuryād haribhaktyā samanvitaḥ

children.translated_text: goes to <s>Viṣṇu's</s> world in a swan-yoked celestial chariot. || 86 ||

body.translated_text: One who performs circumambulation endowed with devotion to <s>Hari</s>

children.translated_text: do not equal a sixteenth part of a single prostration to <s>Nārāyaṇa</s>. || 87 ||

body.translated_text: Thousands of <s>koṭis</s> (ten millions) of sacred bathing places and hundreds of <s>koṭis</s> of vows

body.text: urasā śirasā dṛṣṭyā manasā vacasā tathā

children.translated_text: with the feet, with the hands, and with the knees — this is declared to be the eightfold prostration (<s>aṣṭāṅga</s>). || 88 ||

body.translated_text: With the chest, with the head, with the gaze, with the mind, with speech,

children.text: śātajanmārjitaṃ pāpaṃ naśyaty eva na saṃśayaḥ. || 89 ||
children.translated_text: the sin accumulated over a hundred births is surely destroyed, without doubt. || 89 ||

body.translated_text: Even one who prostrates to the bearer of the <s>Śārṅga</s> bow with insincerity —

children.text: nānyo dharttā jagannāthaṃ muktvā nārāyaṇaṃ param. || 90 ||
children.translated_text: there is no other savior except <s>Nārāyaṇa</s>, the supreme lord of the universe. || 90 ||

body.translated_text: For those drowning in the ocean of <s>saṃsāra</s>, for the lowest of men, for the sinful —

children.translated_text: for that many thousands of years one is glorified in the world of <s>Viṣṇu</s>, O <s>Bhārata</s>. || 91 ||

body.translated_text: As many particles of dust as adhere to the body in <s>Viṣṇu's</s> [temple],

children.translated_text: but if one eats the food offering of another deity, one should perform the <s>Cāndrāyaṇa</s> penance. || 92 ||

body.translated_text: The food offering (<s>naivedya</s>) to <s>Viṣṇu</s> is purifying and considered most excellent food by the sages;

children.text: yat phalaṃ labhyate pumbhir viṣṇor naivedya bhakṣaṇāt. || 93 ||
children.translated_text: [is the same as that obtained] from eating <s>Viṣṇu's</s> food offering. || 93 ||

body.translated_text: The fruit obtained by men through thousands of <s>koṭis</s> of <s>Cāndrāyaṇa</s> penances and <s>koṭis</s> of monthly fasts

children.text: samudragās tu pakṣasya māsasya saritāṃ patiḥ. || 94 ||
children.translated_text: those reaching the ocean bestow a fortnight's [merit]; and the lord of rivers, a month's. || 94 ||

body.translated_text: Rivers that do not reach the ocean bestow the fruit of a three-night [penance];

children.translated_text: [yet] these do not equal a sixteenth part of the water from <s>Viṣṇu's</s> feet. || 95 ||

body.translated_text: The <s>Godāvarī</s> bestows the fruit of six months, and the <s>Jāhnavī</s> (Ganges) a year's;

children.text: kālena tīrthasalilāni punanti pāpaṃ pādodakaṃ bhagavataḥ prapunāti sadyaḥ. || 96 ||
children.translated_text: [even when] visited repeatedly, the waters of these sacred places purify sin over time; but the water from the Lord's feet purifies instantly. || 96 ||

body.translated_text: The <s>Gaṅgā</s>, <s>Prayāga</s>, <s>Gayā</s>, <s>Puṣkara</s>, <s>Naimiśa</s>, and <s>Kurujāṅgala</s> —

body.text: yāni kāni ca tīrthāni brahmāṇḍāntargatāni vai

children.translated_text: they do not equal a sixteenth part of the water from <s>Viṣṇu's</s> feet. || 97 ||

body.translated_text: Whatever sacred places there are within the entire <s>brahmāṇḍa</s> (cosmic egg) —

body.text: snānaṃ pādodakaṃ viṣṇoḥ piban śirasi dhārayan

children.translated_text: becomes freed from all sins and attains the <s>Vaiṣṇava</s> perfection. || 98 ||

body.translated_text: One who bathes [in], drinks, and bears upon one's head the water from <s>Viṣṇu's</s> feet

children.text: naivedyaṃ dhūpaśeṣaṃ ca ārārttiś ca tathā hareḥ. || 99 ||
children.translated_text: the food offering, the remnant incense, and the <s>ārati</s> (lamp-waving ceremony) of <s>Hari</s>! || 99 ||

body.translated_text: How holy is the water from His feet, the remnant garlands, the ointment,

body.text: tulasyās tu rajojuṣṭaṃ naivedyasya ca bhakṣaṇam

children.translated_text: and wearing the remnant garlands upon the head — this destroys even the greatest sins. || 100 ||

body.translated_text: Eating what is touched by the dust of <s>tulasī</s> and the food offering,

body.text: bhaktyā vā yadi vā 'bhaktyā cakrāṅkitaśilām prati

children.translated_text: merely seeing or touching it destroys all sins. || 101 ||

body.translated_text: Whether with devotion or without devotion, toward a stone marked with the discus (<s>cakra</s>),

children.translated_text: with the bathing-water of both, one removes even the sin of killing a <s>brāhmaṇa</s>. || 102 ||

body.translated_text: The deity born from the <s>Śālagrāma</s> and the deity born from <s>Dvāravatī</s> —

children.text: yojanāni tathā trīṇi mama kṣetraṃ vasundhare. || 103 ||
children.translated_text: for three <s>yojanas</s> around it is My sacred field, O Earth. || 103 ||

body.translated_text: Even in a <s>mleccha</s> (barbarian) land or in an impure place, wherever a discus-marked [stone] exists,

children.translated_text: wherever it is taken, that place becomes greater than a hundred <s>Vārāṇasīs</s>. || 104 ||

body.translated_text: The deity born from the <s>Śālagrāma</s>, the stone adorned with the discus mark —

children.text: ubhayoḥ saṃgamo yatra tatra muktir na saṃśayaḥ. || 105 ||
children.translated_text: where both come together, there liberation is assured, without doubt. || 105 ||

body.translated_text: The deity born from the <s>Śālagrāma</s> and the deity born from <s>Dvāravatī</s> —

children.text: sa yasya sarvabhāveṣu tasya taiḥ kiṃ prayojanam. || 106 ||
children.translated_text: for one in whose every being He abides, what need has such a one for those [places]? || 106 ||

body.translated_text: By <s>Hari</s>, who grants liberation, all places of liberation have been established everywhere;

body.text: harir yāti harir yāti dasyuvyājena yo vadet

children.text: so 'pi sadgatim āpnoti gatiṃ sukṛtino yathā. || 107 ||
children.translated_text: even that person attains a good destiny, like one of meritorious deeds. || 107 ||

body.translated_text: One who says '<s>Hari</s> goes! <s>Hari</s> goes!' in the manner of a thief [calling out in fear] —

children.text: tyaktvā 'mṛtaṃ sa mūḍhātmā bhuṅkte hālāhalaṃ viṣam. || 108 ||
children.translated_text: is a deluded soul who abandons nectar and consumes <s>hālāhala</s> poison. || 108 ||

body.translated_text: One who abandons <s>Vāsudeva</s> and worships another deity

body.text: tyaktvāmṛtaṃ yathā kaścid anyapānaṃ piben naraḥ

children.text: tathā hariṃ parityajya cānyaṃ devam upāsate. || 109 ||
children.translated_text: so is one who, abandoning <s>Hari</s>, worships another deity. || 109 ||

body.translated_text: Just as a man who, abandoning nectar, drinks some other beverage,

body.text: svadharmaṃ tu parityajya paradharmaṃ yathā caret

children.text: tathā hariṃ parityajya cānyaṃ devam upāsate. || 110 ||
children.translated_text: so is one who, abandoning <s>Hari</s>, worships another deity. || 110 ||

body.translated_text: Just as one who, abandoning one's own <s>dharma</s>, follows another's <s>dharma</s>,

body.text: gāṃ ca tyaktvā vimūḍhātmā gardabhīṃ vandate yathā

children.text: tathā hariṃ parityajya cānyaṃ devam upāsate. || 111 ||
children.translated_text: so is one who, abandoning <s>Hari</s>, worships another deity. || 111 ||

body.translated_text: Just as a deluded soul who, abandoning a cow, worships a she-donkey,

children.translated_text: The foolish one, thirsty on the bank of the <s>Jāhnavī</s> [Ganges], digs a well. [<s>MKm</s> 112]

body.translated_text: One who abandons <s>Vāsudeva</s> and worships another deity

body.text: yathā gaṅgodakaṃ tyaktvā pibet kūpodakaṃ naraḥ

children.text: tathā hariṃ parityajya yo 'nyaṃ devam upāsate. || 113 ||
children.translated_text: so is one who, forsaking <s>Hari</s>, worships another god. [<s>MKm</s> 113]

body.translated_text: Just as a man who, abandoning the water of the <s>Gaṅgā</s>, would drink well-water,

children.text: tathā hariṃ parityajya yo 'nyaṃ devam upāsate. || 114 ||
children.translated_text: so is one who, forsaking <s>Hari</s>, worships another god. [<s>MKm</s> 114]

body.translated_text: Just as one who, abandoning one's own mother, bows to an outcaste woman,

body.text: yāvat svastham idaṃ piṇḍaṃ nirujaṃ karaṇānvitam

children.translated_text: so long do what is beneficial for yourself; afterward you will burn with anguish. [<s>MKm</s> 115]

body.translated_text: As long as this body is healthy, free from disease, endowed with faculties,

body.text: yāvat svāsthyaṃ śarīreṣu karaṇeṣu ca pāṭavam

children.text: tāvad arcaya govindam āyuśyaṃ sārthakaṃ kuru. || 116 ||
children.translated_text: so long worship <s>Govinda</s> — make your lifespan fruitful. [<s>MKm</s> 116]

body.translated_text: As long as there is health in the body and sharpness in the faculties,

body.text: smaryatāṃ tu hṛṣīkeśo hṛṣīkeṣu dṛḍheṣu ca

children.translated_text: when the senses are no longer firm, who remembers <s>Hṛṣīkeśa</s>? [<s>MKm</s> 117]

body.translated_text: Let <s>Hṛṣīkeśa</s> be remembered while the senses are still firm;

children.text: tāvac cet smarate viṣṇuṃ ko na mucyeta bandhanāt. || 118 ||
children.translated_text: if for that long one remembers <s>Viṣṇu</s>, who would not be freed from bondage? [<s>MKm</s> 118]

body.translated_text: As long as a creature thinks upon sense-objects that are like poison,

children.text: tāvac cet smarate viṣṇuṃ ko na mucyeta bandhanāt. || 119 ||
children.translated_text: if for that long one remembers <s>Viṣṇu</s>, who would not be freed from bondage? [<s>MKm</s> 119]

body.translated_text: As long as a creature prattles about sense-objects that are like poison,

children.translated_text: <s>Sūta</s> said:

children.text: jñātvā viprās tithiṃ samyag daivajñaiḥ samudīritām
children.translated_text: Having properly ascertained the <s>tithi</s> as declared by astrologers, O <s>brāhmaṇas</s>,

children.text: kartavya upavāsaś ca anyathā narakaṃ vrajet. || 120 ||
children.translated_text: the fast should be observed; otherwise one goes to hell. [<s>MKm</s> 120]

body.text: kṣaye vā 'py athavā vṛddhau samprāpte vā dinakṣaye

children.translated_text: the meritorious <s>Dvādaśī</s> should be observed as the fast; one contaminated by the previous [day] should be abandoned. [<s>MKm</s> 121]

body.translated_text: Whether at the waning, or at the waxing, or when the day-end (<s>dinakṣaya</s>) has arrived,

children.text: saṃtates tu vināśāya sampado haraṇāya ca. || 122 ||
children.translated_text: leading to the destruction of his lineage and the loss of his prosperity. [<s>MKm</s> 122]

body.translated_text: A man who observes [an <s>Ekādaśī</s>] contaminated by the previous [<s>Daśamī</s>] cuts down his merits,

children.text: surāyā bindunā spṛṣṭaṃ gaṅgāmbha iva santyajet. || 123 ||
children.translated_text: just as one should abandon <s>Gaṅgā</s> water touched by a drop of liquor. [<s>MKm</s> 123]

body.translated_text: O best of <s>brāhmaṇas</s>, when there is contamination [of <s>Ekādaśī</s>] even by a fraction [of <s>Daśamī</s>], one should abandon the <s>Ekādaśī</s> —

body.text: śvadṛtau pañcagavyaṃ ca daśamyā dūṣitāṃ tyajet

children.translated_text: O best of twice-born, in both fortnights. [<s>MKm</s> 124]

body.translated_text: Like <s>pañcagavya</s> [the five cow-products] in a dog's skin, one should abandon an <s>Ekādaśī</s> contaminated by <s>Daśamī</s>,

body.text: tasmād viprā na viddhā hi kartavyaikādasī kvacit

children.text: viddhā hanti purāpuṇyaṃ śrāddhaṃ ca vṛṣalīpatiḥ. || 125 ||
children.translated_text: a contaminated one destroys prior merit, like a <s>śrāddha</s> [performed by] the husband of a <s>śūdra</s> woman. [<s>MKm</s> 125]

body.translated_text: Therefore, O <s>brāhmaṇas</s>, a contaminated <s>Ekādaśī</s> should never be observed;

body.text: japtaṃ dattaṃ hutaṃ snātaṃ tathā pūjā kṛtā hareḥ

children.text: tat sarvaṃ vilayaṃ yāti tamaḥ sūryodaye yathā. || 126 ||
children.translated_text: all that is dissolved, like darkness at sunrise. [<s>MKm</s> 126]

body.translated_text: Whatever has been chanted, given, offered in fire, bathed, or worship performed for <s>Hari</s> —

children.text: upoṣyā dvādaśī tatra trayodaśyāṃ tu pāraṇam. || 127 ||
children.translated_text: the <s>Dvādaśī</s> should be observed as the fast, with breaking the fast on <s>Trayodaśī</s>. [<s>MKm</s> 127]

body.translated_text: O <s>brāhmaṇa</s>, when on <s>Ekādaśī</s> there occurs a day-end <s>tithi</s>,

children.translated_text: should be known as complete — except the day of <s>Hari</s> [<s>Ekādaśī</s>]. [<s>MKm</s> 128]

body.translated_text: All <s>tithis</s> beginning with <s>Pratipad</s>, from sunrise to sunrise,

children.translated_text: then the <s>Ekādaśī</s> fast should be known as the root of sin. [<s>MKm</s> 129]

body.translated_text: If at the time of dawn (<s>aruṇodaya</s>) the <s>Daśamī</s> is seen,

children.translated_text: the <s>Ekādaśī</s> should not be observed [then], as it destroys <s>dharma</s>, desire, and wealth. [<s>MKm</s> 130]

body.translated_text: If at the time of dawn the <s>Daśamī</s> is seen,

children.translated_text: this is the bathing time for ascetics, said to be equal to [bathing in] the waters of the <s>Gaṅgā</s>. [<s>MKm</s> 131]

body.translated_text: Four <s>ghaṭikās</s> before [sunrise] in the morning is called dawn (<s>aruṇodaya</s>);

children.translated_text: it is called a complete <s>Ekādaśī</s> — the votary should fast on that very day. [<s>MKm</s> 132]

body.translated_text: O <s>brāhmaṇas</s>, when before sunrise [the <s>Ekādaśī</s>] extends by two <s>muhūrtas</s>,

body.text: udayāt prāk trighaṭikā vyāpiny ekādaśī yadā

children.translated_text: it is called a doubtful <s>Ekādaśī</s> — it should be avoided as it destroys <s>dharma</s> and wealth. [<s>MKm</s> 133]

body.translated_text: When the <s>Ekādaśī</s> extends only three <s>ghaṭikās</s> before sunrise,

children.text: tatra kratuśataṃ puṇyaṃ trayodaśyāṃ tu pāraṇaṃ. || 134 ||
children.translated_text: therein lies the merit of a hundred sacrifices, with breaking the fast on <s>Trayodaśī</s>. [<s>MKm</s> 134]

body.translated_text: For the increase of sons and grandsons, one should fast on <s>Dvādaśī</s>;

children.translated_text: it is called a mixed <s>Ekādaśī</s> — it should be avoided by those who desire <s>dharma</s> and wealth. [<s>MKm</s> 135]

body.translated_text: When the <s>Ekādaśī</s> extends only two <s>ghaṭikās</s> before sunrise,

children.text: tatra kratuśataṃ puṇyaṃ trayodaśyāṃ tu pāraṇam. || 136 ||
children.translated_text: therein lies the merit of a hundred sacrifices, with breaking the fast on <s>Trayodaśī</s>. [<s>MKm</s> 136]

body.translated_text: For the increase of sons and kingdom, one should fast on <s>Dvādaśī</s>;

children.text: tasyāḥ putraśataṃ naṣṭaṃ tasmāt tāṃ parivarjayet. || 137 ||
children.translated_text: her hundred sons were destroyed — therefore one should avoid that. [<s>MKm</s> 137]

body.translated_text: [An <s>Ekādaśī</s>] joined with a remnant of <s>Daśamī</s> was observed by <s>Gāndhārī</s>;

children.text: upoṣyā dvādaśī puṇyā trayodaśyāṃ tu pāraṅam. || 138 ||
children.translated_text: the meritorious <s>Dvādaśī</s> should be observed as the fast, with breaking the fast on <s>Trayodaśī</s>. [<s>MKm</s> 138]

body.translated_text: When there are conflicts among many scriptures and disputes among <s>brāhmaṇas</s>,

body.text: ekādaśyāṃ tu viddhāyāṃ samprāpte śravaṇe tathā

children.text: upoṣyā dvādaśī puṇyā pakṣayor ubhayor api. || 139 ||
children.translated_text: the meritorious <s>Dvādaśī</s> should be observed in both fortnights. [<s>MKm</s> 139]

body.translated_text: When <s>Ekādaśī</s> is contaminated and the <s>Śravaṇa</s> [<s>nakṣatra</s>] has arrived,

children.text: amālakṣaṃ tu dvādaśyāḥ kalāṃ nārhanti ṣoḍaśīm. || 140 ||
children.translated_text: do not equal a sixteenth fraction of an <s>Āmalakī Dvādaśī</s>. [<s>MKm</s> 140]

body.translated_text: Thousands of eclipses (<s>uparāga</s>) and tens of thousands of <s>vyatīpāta</s> [inauspicious conjunctions]

children.text: śuddhāpi dvādaśī grāhyā parato dvādaśī yadi
children.translated_text: Even a pure <s>Dvādaśī</s> should be taken if the <s>Dvādaśī</s> [extends] beyond [the next day];

children.text: viṣaṃ tu daśamī jñeyā 'mṛtaṃ caikādaśī tithiḥ.
children.translated_text: <s>Daśamī</s> should be known as poison, and the <s>Ekādaśī tithi</s> as nectar.
One dominated by poison should be avoided; the one dominated by nectar should be accepted. [<s>MKm</s> 141]
that dull-witted person goes to hell. [<s>MKm</s> 142]

body.translated_text: One who eats on <s>Dvādaśī</s> while the contaminated <s>Ekādaśī</s> is the day for fasting to <s>Hari</s>,

body.text: yāni kāni ca vākyāni viddhopāsyāparāṇi tu

children.translated_text: they are oriented toward worship of <s>Dhanada</s> [<s>Kubera</s>]; the <s>Vaiṣṇavī</s> [<s>Ekādaśī</s>] is not [just] ten thousand. [<s>MKm</s> 143]

body.translated_text: Whatever statements [support] observing the contaminated [<s>Ekādaśī</s>] or [focus on] other matters,

children.translated_text: caused [such teachings] to be made, [appearing] in the form of <s>Vyāsa</s>, [being] <s>Janārdana</s>. [<s>MKm</s> 144]

body.translated_text: Or, for the purpose of delusion, the <s>Bhagavān Hari</s>, entreated by <s>Mohinī</s>,

children.translated_text: For the purpose of increasing the worship of <s>Dhanada</s> and great loss of wealth,
for the delusion of demons and the increase of heretics,
and for preventing the knowledge of one's own true nature and the attainment of one's true form. [<s>MKm</s> 145]
Thus, by abandoning the contaminated [<s>Ekādaśī</s>] and fasting on <s>Dvādaśī</s>,
sins accumulated over ten million births are destroyed by that single [fast],
and even a hundred million times more so when prohibited by others. [<s>MKm</s> 146]

children.text: yad anādikṛtaṃ pāpaṃ tad ūrdhvaṃ yat kariṣyati
children.translated_text: Whatever sin has been committed since beginningless time, and whatever one will commit hereafter —

children.text: tat sarvaṃ vilayaṃ yāti pareṣām upavāsanāt
children.translated_text: all that is dissolved through fasting on the succeeding [day];

children.text: na ca tasmāt priyatamaḥ keśavasya mamāpi vā. || 147 ||
children.translated_text: and no one is dearer to <s>Keśava</s> or to me than such a person. [<s>MKm</s> 147]

body.text: ekādaśyā hy avedhe tu dvādaśīṃ na parityajet

children.text: pāraṇe maraṇe caiva tithis tātkālikī smṛtā. || 148 ||
children.translated_text: for breaking the fast and for death, the <s>tithi</s> current at that time is authoritative. [<s>MKm</s> 148]

body.translated_text: When the <s>Ekādaśī</s> is uncontaminated, one should not abandon the <s>Dvādaśī</s>;

body.text: brahmacārī gṛhastho vā vānaprastho yatis tathā

children.text: brāhmaṇaḥ kṣatriyo vaiśyaḥ śūdro bhartṛmatī tathā. || 149 ||
children.translated_text: whether a <s>brāhmaṇa</s>, <s>kṣatriya</s>, <s>vaiśya</s>, <s>śūdra</s>, or a married woman, [<s>MKm</s> 149]

body.translated_text: Whether a celibate student, householder, forest-dweller, or renunciant,

children.text: ekādaśyāṃ na bhuñjīta pakṣayor ubhayor api. || 150 ||
children.translated_text: none should eat on <s>Ekādaśī</s>, in both fortnights. [<s>MKm</s> 150]

body.translated_text: or an unmarried woman, or others such as <s>Sūta</s>, <s>Vaideha</s>, and the like —

children.text: śuklāyām atha kṛṣṇāyāṃ nirayaṃ yāti sa dhruvam. || 151 ||
children.translated_text: whether on the bright or dark [fortnight], surely goes to hell. [<s>MKm</s> 151]

body.translated_text: Whoever eats on <s>Ekādaśī</s>, consciousness clouded by delusion,

body.text: vivecayati yo mohāc chuklā kṛṣṇeti pāpakṛt

children.text: ekādaśīṃ sa vai yāti nirayaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ. || 152 ||
children.translated_text: regarding <s>Ekādaśī</s>, goes to hell — there is no doubt in this. [<s>MKm</s> 152]

body.translated_text: The sinner who, out of delusion, discriminates 'this is the bright, this is the dark' [<s>Ekādaśī</s>],

body.text: yathā gaur naiva hantavyā śuklā kṛṣṇeti bhāmini

children.text: ekadāśyāṃ na bhuñjīta pakṣayor ubhayor api. || 153 ||
children.translated_text: so one should not eat on <s>Ekādaśī</s>, in both fortnights. [<s>MKm</s> 153]

body.translated_text: Just as a cow should not be killed, whether white or black, O beautiful one,

children.translated_text: and the prohibition on [days with] <s>Bharaṇī</s> [<s>nakṣatra</s>] and the like, those are for seekers of particular desired fruits. [<s>MKm</s> 154]

body.translated_text: Whatever statements exist regarding the avoidance of the dark <s>Ekādaśī</s>

children.text: prīṇanārthaṃ harer nityaṃ na tu kāmavyapekṣayā. || 155 ||
children.translated_text: always for the satisfaction of <s>Hari</s>, not with regard to [personal] desires. [<s>MKm</s> 155]

body.translated_text: Even those with [particular] desires should perform the fast for the sake of the eternal purpose,

children.text: tasmāc chuklām atho kṛṣṇāṃ bharaṇyādiyutām api
children.translated_text: Therefore, whether bright or dark [<s>Ekādaśī</s>], even if conjoined with <s>Bharaṇī</s> and the like,
one should always fast, for the purpose of avoiding adverse consequences,
and for satisfying <s>Hari</s>, and for attaining the world of <s>Viṣṇu</s>. [<s>MKm</s> 156]

body.text: kalā vā ghaṭikā vā 'pi apare dvādaśī yadi

children.translated_text: it destroys twelve <s>Dvādaśīs</s> if the fast is broken on the day before. [<s>MKm</s> 157]

body.translated_text: If even a fraction or a <s>ghaṭikā</s> of <s>Dvādaśī</s> extends beyond [the next day],

body.text: atiriktā dvādaśī cet sa tāṃ nopoṣayed yadi

children.translated_text: it destroys twelve <s>Dvādaśīs</s>, and the <s>Dvādaśī</s> is transgressed. [<s>MKm</s> 158]

body.translated_text: If the <s>Dvādaśī</s> is in excess, and one does not fast on it,

children.translated_text: destroys twelve <s>Dvādaśīs</s> — one should not abandon the <s>Dvādaśī</s>. [<s>MKm</s> 159]

body.translated_text: One who eats on the day before when the <s>Dvādaśī</s> is in excess

children.translated_text: the merit accumulated over five years is destroyed for that person. [<s>MKm</s> 160]

body.translated_text: The exceedingly dull-witted person who does not fast on a <s>Dvādaśī</s> conjoined with <s>Śravaṇa</s> [<s>nakṣatra</s>] —

children.text: na tatra vidhilopaḥ syād ubhayor devatā hariḥ. || 161 ||
children.translated_text: there is no violation of the rule therein, for the deity of both is <s>Hari</s>. [<s>MKm</s> 161]

body.translated_text: Having fasted on <s>Ekādaśī</s>, one should also fast on <s>Dvādaśī</s>;

children.translated_text: Having broken the fast even with water alone, one who eats is not at fault,
since water is declared by the learned to be both eaten and not eaten —
'With water alone I shall break the vow.' [<s>MKm</s> 162]

body.text: na kāśī na gayā gaṅgā na reva na ca gautamī

children.text: na cāpi kauravaṃ kṣetraṃ samā bhūpa harer dināt. || 163 ||
children.translated_text: nor the field of the <s>Kurus</s> are equal, O king, to the day of <s>Hari</s>. [<s>MKm</s> 163]

body.translated_text: Neither <s>Kāśī</s>, nor <s>Gayā</s>, the <s>Gaṅgā</s>, the <s>Revā</s>, the <s>Gautamī</s>,

children.translated_text: do not equal a sixteenth fraction of the <s>Ekādaśī</s> fast. [<s>MKm</s> 164]

body.translated_text: Thousands of <s>Aśvamedha</s> sacrifices and tens of thousands of <s>Vājapeya</s> sacrifices

children.translated_text: is reduced to ashes, O king, even if born from a hundred births. [<s>MKm</s> 165]

body.translated_text: By the fire arisen from <s>Ekādaśī</s>, the fuel of sin

body.text: nedṛśaṃ pāvanaṃ kiñcin narāṇāṃ bhuvi vidyate

children.translated_text: like the day of <s>Padmanābha</s> [<s>Viṣṇu</s>], which removes sin. [<s>MKm</s> 166]

body.translated_text: There is no purification for mortals on earth

children.translated_text: as long as a creature does not fast on the auspicious day of <s>Padmanābha</s>. [<s>MKm</s> 167]

body.translated_text: Sins remain in this body, O lord of men,

body.text: ekādaśendriyaiḥ pāpaṃ yat kṛtaṃ bhavati prabho

children.translated_text: By fasting on <s>Ekādaśī</s>, all that is dissolved. (168)

body.translated_text: Whatever sin is committed by the eleven senses, O lord,

children.text: vyājenāpi kṛtā rājan na darśayati bhāskarim. || 169 ||
children.translated_text: even when observed under pretext, O king, it prevents one from seeing the realm of the sun (hell). (169)

body.translated_text: There is no protection from sin equal to <s>Ekādaśī</s>;

children.translated_text: <s>Śrī Vedavyāsa</s> said:

children.text: sa brahmahā sa goghnaś ca stenaḥ sa gurutalpagaḥ
children.translated_text: He is a slayer of a <s>brāhmaṇa</s>, he is a cow-killer, a thief, and a violator of the guru's bed —

children.text: ekādaśyāṃ tu bhuñjānaḥ pakṣayor ubhayor api. || 170 ||
children.translated_text: one who eats on <s>Ekādaśī</s> in both fortnights. (170)

children.text: varaṃ hatyā surāpānam ekādaśyāṃ tu bhojanāt. || 171 ||
children.translated_text: better to commit murder and drink liquor than to eat on <s>Ekādaśī</s>. (171)

body.translated_text: Better to approach one's own mother, better to eat cow's flesh,

children.translated_text: after seeing their faces, one should look at the sun [for purification]. (172)

body.translated_text: Those lowest of men who eat on the sacred day of <s>Ekādaśī</s> —

children.translated_text: take refuge in food when the day of <s>Hari</s> arrives. (173)

body.translated_text: All the sins on earth, including the killing of a <s>brāhmaṇa</s>,

children.translated_text: <s>Rugmāṅgada</s> [said]:

children.text: aṣṭavarṣādhiko yas tu aśītir na hi pūryate
children.translated_text: One who is above eight years of age and has not yet reached eighty,

children.text: yo bhuṅkte mānavaḥ pāpo viṣṇor ahani cāgate. || 174 ||
children.translated_text: the sinful person who eats on the day of <s>Viṣṇu</s> when it arrives — (174)

body.text: pitā vā yadi vā putro bhāryā vā 'pi suhṛjjanaḥ

children.translated_text: whoever eats on the day of <s>Padmanābha</s> should be restrained like a bandit. (175)

body.translated_text: whether father, son, wife, or friend,

children.translated_text: <s>Dharmavibhūṣaṇa</s> [said]:
In the morning on <s>Hari</s>'s day, O people, remain with a single meal,
all of you abstaining from alkali and salt, consuming only <s>haviṣya</s> (sacrificial food). (176)
remember the God of gods, the Supreme Being of the ancient <s>Purāṇas</s>. (177)

body.translated_text: Sleeping on the ground, free from the company of the beloved,

children.translated_text: without performing the accumulated <s>śrāddha</s> rites, and making water and <s>piṇḍa</s> offerings. (178)

body.translated_text: You shall observe the fast with a single meal,

children.translated_text: <s>Brahmā</s> [said]:
Having fasted on the sacred <s>Dvādaśī</s>, which grants the destruction of all sins,

children.text: na paśyati yamaṃ vā 'pi narakān na ca yātanām. || 179 ||
children.translated_text: one sees neither <s>Yama</s> nor the hells nor any torments. (179)

children.text: na bhoktavyaṃ na bhoktavyaṃ samprāpte harivāsare. || 180 ||
children.translated_text: 'One must not eat, one must not eat, when the day of <s>Hari</s> arrives.' (180)

body.translated_text: The <s>Purāṇas</s> proclaim again and again, O beautiful-faced one:

body.text: dvādaśī na pramoktavyā yāvad āyuḥ pravartate

children.translated_text: <s>Hṛṣīkeśa</s> (Viṣṇu) is to be worshipped with a purified inner self. (181)

body.translated_text: <s>Dvādaśī</s> must not be neglected as long as life continues;

body.text: bhaktyā grāhyo hṛṣīkeśo na dhanair dharaṇīsurāḥ

children.text: bhaktyā sampūjito viṣṇuḥ phalaṃ datte samīhitam. || 182 ||
children.translated_text: <s>Viṣṇu</s>, when properly worshipped with devotion, grants the desired fruit. (182)

body.translated_text: <s>Hṛṣīkeśa</s> is to be grasped through devotion, not through wealth, O earthly gods (<s>brāhmaṇas</s>);

children.text: paritoṣaṃ prayāty āśu tṛṣārtās tu yathā jalaiḥ. || 183 ||
children.translated_text: quickly becomes satisfied, just as one who is thirsty is satisfied by water. (183)

body.translated_text: Even when worshipped with mere water, <s>Jagannātha</s> (Lord of the World), the destroyer of afflictions,

children.translated_text: dwell always in my heart, O <s>Puṇḍarīkākṣa</s> (Lotus-eyed One). (184)

body.translated_text: Whether I am sitting, lying down, standing, or walking —

children.translated_text: dwell in my heart, O <s>Puṇḍarīkākṣa</s>, O <s>Nṛsiṃha</s>. (185)

body.translated_text: O all-pervading one, O soul of all, O <s>Acyuta</s> (Imperishable One), in all conditions,

children.translated_text: for I am forever sinking in the terrible ocean of the mire of worldly existence. (186)

body.translated_text: Extend your hand to me, O <s>Śrī Kṛṣṇa</s>, O lotus-eyed one,

children.translated_text: Lift me up, O <s>Govinda</s>, from the ocean of miserable worldly existence. (187)

body.translated_text: Save me, save me, O <s>Jagannātha</s>, O <s>Vāsudeva</s>, <s>Acyuta</s>, Imperishable One!

body.text: etat puṇyaṃ paraṃ guhyaṃ pavitraṃ pāpanāśanam

children.translated_text: life-giving, fame-bestowing, and destructive of bad dreams in the <s>Kali</s> age. (188)

body.translated_text: This is meritorious, supremely secret, sanctifying, and sin-destroying,

children.translated_text: when <s>Govinda</s> is remembered in the mind, it is burned like a heap of cotton. (189)

body.translated_text: In the <s>Kali</s> age, however much sin may arise from murder, theft, and the like,

body.text: kalau keśavabhaktānāṃ na bhayaṃ vidyate kvacit

children.text: smṛte saṃkīrtite dhyāte saṃkṣayaṃ yāti pātakam. || 190 ||
children.translated_text: through remembrance, chanting, and meditation, sin is utterly destroyed. (190)

body.translated_text: For devotees of <s>Keśava</s> in the <s>Kali</s> age, there is no fear anywhere;

children.text: bhaktebhyaś ca pradātavyaṃ dhārmikebhyaḥ punaḥ punaḥ. || 191 ||
children.translated_text: and given again and again to devotees and righteous persons. (191)

body.translated_text: This scripture should be studied, listened to without envy,

body.text: adhīyāna idaṃ śāstram viṣṇor māhātmyam uttamam

children.translated_text: freed from all sins, attains the highest state. (192)

body.translated_text: One who studies this scripture, the supreme glory of <s>Viṣṇu</s>,

body.text: śrutvā dharmaṃ vijānāti śrutvā tyajati durmatim

children.text: śrutvā jñānam avāpnoti śrutvā mokṣaṃ ca gacchati. || 193 ||
children.translated_text: by hearing, one attains knowledge; by hearing, one reaches liberation. (193)

body.translated_text: By hearing, one understands <s>Dharma</s>; by hearing, one abandons wrong views;

body.text: tasmād idaṃ samāśrāvyaṃ śrotavyaṃ ca sadaiva hi

children.translated_text: but it should never be given to those burned by the forest fire of false reasoning. (194)

body.translated_text: Therefore this should always be made heard and listened to;

children.translated_text: the <s>Kṛṣṇāmṛtamahārṇava</s> (Great Ocean of the Nectar of Kṛṣṇa) is remembered as their nectar of immortality. (195)

body.translated_text: For those beings on earth who have died by drinking the poison of <s>saṃsāra</s> (worldly existence),

children.translated_text: is considered to have bathed daily at tens of millions of holy pilgrimage sites. (196)

body.translated_text: One whose body is always moistened by the water that has washed His feet

children.translated_text: if one daily drinks the water that has flowed from the <s>Śālagrāma</s> stone? (197)

body.translated_text: What purpose is served by visiting tens of millions of pilgrimage sites

children.translated_text: even the gods along with <s>Indra</s> desire the touch of their hands. (198)

body.translated_text: Those who daily touch the <s>Śālagrāma</s> stone —

children.translated_text: perilous is the path ending at death, and the state of a <s>preta</s> (ghost) is most terrible. (199)

body.translated_text: Unbearable is the fire of hell, unbearable are the servants of <s>Yama</s>,

children.text: smaraṇaṃ kīrtanaṃ viṣṇoḥ sadaiva na parityajet. || 200 ||
children.translated_text: and never abandon the remembrance and chanting of <s>Viṣṇu</s>. (200)

body.translated_text: Reflecting upon this in the mind, one should turn away from sin

children.translated_text: <s>Śrī Vedavyāsa</s> [said]:
Frightened by the utterance of the names <s>Acyuta</s>, <s>Ananta</s>, and <s>Govinda</s>,

children.text: naśyanti sakalā rogāḥ satyaṃ satyaṃ vadāmy aham. || 201 ||
children.translated_text: all diseases perish — truly, truly, I declare. (201)

body.text: sakṛd uccāritaṃ yena harir ity akṣaradvayam

children.text: baddhaḥ parikaras tena mokṣāya gamanaṃ prati. || 202 ||
children.translated_text: that person has girded himself for the journey toward liberation. (202)

body.translated_text: By whomever the two syllables '<s>Hari</s>' have been uttered even once,

body.text: evaṃ brahmādayo devā ṛṣayaś ca tapodhanāḥ

children.translated_text: glorify the foremost of the gods, Lord <s>Nārāyaṇa</s>, the Supreme. (203)

body.translated_text: Thus <s>Brahmā</s> and the other gods, and the sages rich in austerities,

body.text: kiṃ tasya dānaiḥ kiṃ tīrthaiḥ kiṃ tapobhiḥ kim adhvaraiḥ

children.text: yo nityaṃ dhyāyate devaṃ nārāyaṇam ananyadhīḥ. || 204 ||
children.translated_text: He who always meditates on the god <s>Nārāyaṇa</s> with single-minded devotion. (204)

body.translated_text: What need has he of charity? What of pilgrimages? What of austerities? What of sacrifices?

body.text: nityotsavo nityatā ca nityaśrīr nityaśo jayaḥ

children.translated_text: for those in whose hearts dwells <s>Bhagavān Hari</s>, the abode of auspiciousness. (205)

body.translated_text: Eternal festivity, eternal satisfaction, eternal prosperity, eternal victory —

body.text: jīvaṃś caturdaśād ūrdhvaṃ puruṣo niyamena tu

children.text: strī vā 'py anūnadaśakaṃ dehaṃ mānuṣam ārjate. || 206 ||
children.translated_text: or a woman who reaches at least ten, obtains a human body. (206)

body.translated_text: A man who lives beyond fourteen years of age, by rule,

children.text: ato 'vittvā paraṃ devaṃ mokṣāśā kā mahāmune. || 207 ||
children.translated_text: therefore, without knowing the Supreme God, what hope is there for liberation, O great sage? (207)

body.translated_text: Those who live beyond fourteen years accumulate <s>saṃsāra</s> from the beginning;

children.translated_text: From the fourteenth year onward, by rule,
one's actions become the causes of at least ten bodies;

children.text: ataḥ karmakṣayān muktiḥ kuta eva bhaviṣyati. || 208 ||
children.translated_text: therefore, how can liberation come about through the exhaustion of karma? (208)

body.text: samānāṃ viṣamā pūjā viṣamāṇāṃ samā tathā

children.text: kriyate yena devo 'pi svapadād bhraśyate hi saḥ. || 209 ||
children.translated_text: even a god falls from his position because of that. (209)

body.translated_text: One who offers equal worship to the unequal, and unequal worship to the equal —

body.text: vittaṃ bandhur vayaḥ karma vidyā caiva tu pañcamī

children.text: etāni mānyasthānāni garīyo yad yad uttaram. || 210 ||
children.translated_text: these are the grounds of honor; each succeeding one is weightier. (210)

body.translated_text: Wealth, kinship, age, deeds, and learning as the fifth —

body.text: guṇānusāriṇīṃ pūjāṃ samāṃ dṛṣṭiṃ ca yo naraḥ

children.translated_text: toward all beings — <s>Viṣṇu</s> is pleased with him. (211)

body.translated_text: The man who offers worship following the qualities and maintains an equal vision

children.text: tathā karoti pūjādi samabuddhiḥ sa ucyate. || 212 ||
children.translated_text: one who performs worship and the like in the same manner is called one of equal mind. (212)

body.translated_text: As one should act toward friends, and toward the sons of one's father's enemies,

body.text: tiryakpuṇḍraṃ na kurvīta samprāpte maraṇe 'pi ca

children.text: na cānyan nāma vibrūyāt paraṃ nārāyaṇādṛte. || 213 ||
children.translated_text: nor utter any other name than that of <s>Nārāyaṇa</s>. (213)

body.translated_text: One should not wear a horizontal <s>tilaka</s> mark, even at the point of death,

body.text: naivedyaśeṣaṃ devasya yo bhunakti dine dine

children.translated_text: at every morsel, merit exceeding a hundred <s>cāndrāyaṇa</s> fasts accrues. (214)

body.translated_text: One who daily eats the remnants of the food offered to the deity —

children.text: sa caṇḍālo 'pi śuddhātmā pūjya eva na saṃśayaḥ. || 215 ||
children.translated_text: even a <s>caṇḍāla</s> (outcaste) is pure-souled and worthy of worship — there is no doubt. (215)

body.translated_text: When a vertical <s>ūrdhvapuṇḍra</s> mark, straight and gentle, is seen upon the forehead,

body.text: aśucir vā 'py anācāro manasā pāpam ācaran

children.text: śucir eva bhaven nityam ūrdhvapuṇḍrānkito naraḥ. || 216 ||
children.translated_text: a man marked with the <s>ūrdhvapuṇḍra</s> is always considered pure. (216)

body.translated_text: Though impure, of bad conduct, or committing sin in thought,

children.translated_text: after seeing such faces, one should look at the sun [for purification]. (217)

body.translated_text: The face of one without the <s>ūrdhvapuṇḍra</s> is like a cremation ground;

body.text: yajño dānaṃ tapaś caiva svādhyāyaḥ pitṛtarpaṇam

children.text: vyarthaṃ bhavati tat sarvam ūrdhvapuṇḍraṃ vinā kṛtam. || 218 ||
children.translated_text: all of these become futile if performed without the <s>ūrdhvapuṇḍra</s>. (218)

body.translated_text: Sacrifice, charity, austerity, self-study, and offering to the ancestors —

children.text: taṃ taṃ śuddhaṃ vijānīyān nātra kāryā vicāraṇā. || 219 ||
children.translated_text: know that person to be pure; no further examination is needed here. (219)

body.translated_text: One whose limbs are anointed with <s>gopīcandana</s> (sacred clay) — whomever he sees with his eyes,

children.translated_text: 'A <s>Vaiṣṇava</s> has been born in our family! He will deliver us all!' (220)

body.translated_text: The ancestors clap their hands, the forefathers dance with joy:

children.text: na tu kalpasahasrais tu bhaktihīnasya keśave. || 221 ||
children.translated_text: than thousands of <s>kalpas</s> (cosmic ages) without devotion to <s>Keśava</s>. (221)

body.translated_text: Better is the life of a devotee of <s>Viṣṇu</s>, even if only five days,

children.text: yo jāto nārcayed viṣṇuṃ na smaren nāpi kīrtayet. || 222 ||
children.translated_text: who, having been born, does not worship <s>Viṣṇu</s>, nor remember Him, nor chant His name? (222)

body.translated_text: What use is one merely born, a burden on the earth, an enemy of food,

children.translated_text: even in the amount of a mustard seed, purifies his lineage up to seven generations. (223)

body.translated_text: One who gives to the twice-born (<s>brāhmaṇas</s>) <s>gopī</s>-ground sandalwood paste,

children.translated_text: without desire, remaining ever constant. (224)

body.translated_text: A wise person should always perform ordained actions

children.translated_text: even such a one should not abandon the practices prescribed by the <s>Śruti</s> and <s>Smṛti</s>. (225)

body.translated_text: Even one who knows the past and future, capable of uplifting the three worlds —

children.translated_text: that indeed becomes more powerful. // <s>MKm</s> 226 //

body.translated_text: Whatever one does with knowledge, faith, and the <s>Upaniṣad</s> —

body.text: kurvan eveha karmāṇi jijīviṣec chataṃ samāḥ

children.text: evaṃ tvayi nānyatheto 'sti na karma lipyate nare. || 227 ||
children.translated_text: Thus for you there is no other way — <s>karma</s> does not cling to a man [who acts thus]. // <s>MKm</s> 227 //

body.translated_text: Performing actions here [in this world], one should wish to live a hundred years.

body.text: ācāraś caiva sādhūnām ātmanas tuṣṭir eva ca

children.translated_text: <s>Dharma</s> is that which is ordained by the <s>Vedas</s>; <s>adharma</s> is the opposite of that. // <s>MKm</s> 228 //

body.translated_text: The conduct of the virtuous and the satisfaction of one's own self —

body.text: niṣkāmaṃ jñānapūrvaṃ tu nivṛttam iha cocyate

children.translated_text: One who follows renunciation attains the eternal <s>Brahman</s>. // <s>MKm</s> 229 //

body.translated_text: That which is desireless, preceded by knowledge, is here called renunciation (<s>nivṛtta</s>).
Thus concludes the <s>Kṛṣṇāmṛtamahārṇava</s>.
